title: Adventures in Silverado
description: A stagecoach driver seeks to capture "The Monk," a notorious highwayman, in order to clear himself.

title: Seminole Uprising
description: An Army lieutenant (George Montgomery) is ordered to go after Florida Indians in Texas.

title: Gunfighters
description: A gunfighter (Randolph Scott) turns cowhand and then back again, fighting a cattle baron with two daughters (Barbara Britton, Dorothy Hart).

title: Phantom Stagecoach
description: A dispute between stage lines ends with a steel-armored stagecoach.

title: Go West, Young Lady
description: A saloon dancer (Ann Miller) and a tomboy (Penny Singleton) from back East fight over their town's new marshal (Glenn Ford).

title: The Gun That Won the West
description: Superior Springfield rifles help scouts (Dennis Morgan, Richard Denning) and the cavalry get forts built in Wyoming.

title: Apache Ambush
description: On a cattle drive to Kansas after the Civil War, an ex-Union soldier comes up against Apache and Confederate renegades.

title: The Professionals
description: A circa-1917 rancher sends mercenaries (Lee Marvin, Burt Lancaster) to rescue his kidnapped wife (Claudia Cardinale) from a Mexican bandit.

title: End of the Trail
description: An Indian sympathizer accused of running guns to the Arapaho is court-martialed by the man who framed him.

title: The Black Dakotas
description: A Confederate plot to turn the Sioux against the Union crumbles when a double agent makes off with a shipment of gold.

title: Mackenna's Gold
description: Apaches, townsfolk, a Mexican bandit (Omar Sharif) and the cavalry follow a sheriff (Gregory Peck) to a mythical canyon of gold.

title: Santa Fe
description: Three brothers become outlaws after the Civil War, while a fourth sibling goes to work for the railroad.

title: Desert Vigilante
description: The Durango Kid (Charles Starrett) bags Mexican-border silver smugglers for Uncle Sam.

title: Blazing the Western Trail
description: A stagecoach operator calls on the Durango Kid when an evil rival attempts to drive him out of business.

title: Riding Wild
description: A ranch foreman tries to thwart a crook's attempts to run his employers off their land.

title: Return of the Durango Kid
description: A stagecoach passenger poses as a masked avenger to track down the thieves who robbed him and his companions.

title: Legend of the Golden Gun
description: An Old West gunfighter (Hal Holbrook) turns a young farmer (Jeff Osterhage) into a justice fighter with a special gun.

title: The Return of Wild Bill
description: Wild Bill Saunders comes home to help his father deal with troublesome ranchers.

title: Sierra Stranger
description: Jess Collins, a poor miner, helps Sonny chase off two men he calls claim jumpers. When he arrives in the nearby town, he learns Sonny is no good and everyone in town is against him.

title: Edge of Eternity
description: An Arizona lawman (Cornel Wilde) traps a killer gold thief (Mickey Shaughnessy) and his hostage (Victoria Shaw) in a yellow tram spanning the Grand Canyon.

title: The Violent Men
description: A rancher (Glenn Ford) fights a land-grabbing cattle baron (Edward G. Robinson) whose wife (Barbara Stanwyck) and brother are having an affair.

title: The Nebraskan
description: War looms on the horizon when an Army officer's American Indian aide is accused of murdering a tribal elder.

title: Gun Fury
description: A peaceful man (Rock Hudson) hunts down the outlaw (Phil Carey) who has abducted his bride (Donna Reed).

title: Apache Territory
description: A drifter crossing the Arizona desert routs a band of marauding Apaches and rescues the young survivor of a massacre.

title: The California Trail
description: Cowboy Santa Fe Stewart (Buck Jones) fights a tyrant in Spanish California.

title: The Longest Drive
description: Two brothers (Kurt Russell, Tim Matheson), one raised by Indians, seek their sister in the 1890s West.

title: North From the Lone Star
description: Wild Bill Hickok (Bill Elliott) puts on a badge to clean up a town.

title: Prairie Schooners
description: Wild Bill Hickok (Bill Elliott) and his pal (Dub Taylor) take a wagon train through Indian country.

title: Daring Danger
description: A wounded cowboy (Tim McCoy) catches rustlers who use a trick branding iron.

title: Return to Warbow
description: Three escaped convicts return to collect the money that the brother of one of them has already spent.

title: Thunderhoof
description: Two men and a young woman in the Mexican wilderness are intent on tracking down a wild stallion.

title: The Untamed Breed
description: Texas ranchers resist an out-of-towner C1 who has a Brahman bull to breed.

title: Brave Warrior
description: Shawnee chief Tecumseh (Jay Silverheels) helps a government agent (Jon Hall) catch traitors before the War of 1812.

title: Two Rode Together
description: A Texas marshal (James Stewart) and a cavalry officer (Richard Widmark) recover long-held captives from Comanches.

title: Avenging Waters
description: A lone cowboy (Ken Maynard) gets the bad guys and wins the gal (Beth Marion).
